quarterly_data.quarter: Equinix press release: Equinix Opens Innovation Centers Globally to Accelerate (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Equinix introduced the Equinix Enhanced Performance Innovation Centers (EPIC), a global network of production-ready liquid cooling environments inside live Equinix data centers where enterprises can trial the latest liquid-cooled GPU and CPU platforms with hardware partners and OEMs and test AI training and inference workloads before large-scale deployment. EPIC is live in Frankfurt, London, Osaka, Paris and Sydney, with more locations expected to open in 2027. SVP Brian Stein: liquid cooling is 'a hard requirement for customer's deploying AI'. Customer Criteo says it tested liquid cooling with Equinix, then committed to scale, making liquid cooling a core part of its distributed AI infrastructure.
quarterly_data.figure: live in Frankfurt, London, Osaka, Paris and Sydney; more locations expected in 2027
